steps.summary: Replayed stored procedure s_f81a61; observed ref=fwod36-n2, quantity=3.00, untaxed_amount_footer_label=Untaxed Amount	£ 885.00, customer_name=fwod36-n2 Bench Customer, customer_city=Benchville, order_reference=S00022, unit_price=295.00, tax_20_percent=£ 177.00, total=£ 1,062.00.

Replayed stored procedure s_1ac9e6; observed line_1={{02-create.product_name}} qty 3.00 @ 295.00 = £885.00, ref=fwod36-n2, customer=fwod36-n2 Bench Customer, line_2_quantity=2.00, line_2_subtotal=£ 140.00, line_2_unit_price=70.00, new_untaxed_amount=£ 1,025.00, order_reference=S00022, tax_20=£ 205.00, total=£ 1,230.00.

Opened the existing draft quotation S00022 (sale.order id 21) for 'fwod36-n2 Bench Customer', clicked into the first line's Quantity cell ({{02-create.product_name}}) and changed it from 3 to 5, committed with Tab, and saved the quotation. After saving the record shows line 1 = {{02-create.product_name}} qty 5.00 @ 295.00 with subtotal £ 1,475.00, and line 2 = {{03-open.line_2_product}} qty 2.00 @ 70.00 with subtotal £ 140.00; the app computes and displays Untaxed Amount £ 1,615.00 (Tax 20% £ 323.00, Total £ 1,938.00). The status bar still marks "Quotation" as the current stage — I did not click Confirm, so the record remains an unconfirmed draft.

Confirmed. I opened quotation S00022 for 'fwod36-n2 Bench Customer' and clicked Confirm; the confirmation completed directly with no dialog shown (dialog handling was armed but capturedDialogs is empty). After confirming, (a) the order reference is S00022 — the page title "Odoo - S00022", breadcrumb "Quotations S00022" and record heading all report the same reference, so the app kept the existing name and did not reassign it; and (b) the status bar now marks "Sales Order" as the current stage (the options render as ... , Sales Order, Quotation Sent, Quotation), replacing the previous "Quotation" state. Confirming also removed the Confirm button, added a Create Invoice button, added Delivered/Invoiced columns to the order lines and turned the customer into a link, all read from the live page after the action. The task is complete; nothing remains outstanding.

Cancelled sales order S00022 as asked. The replayed procedure stopped before opening the cancel wizard, so I inspected the live page first: an accidental "Edit: fwod36-n2 Bench Customer" record dialog was overlaying a "Cancel Sales Order" wizard. I discarded the contact dialog (nothing saved) to expose the wizard, then clicked "Send and cancel", its confirm-cancellation button (the wizard shows "Are you sure you want to cancel this order?"). The record now shows stage "Cancelled" in the status bar (Cancelled radio checked, the other three stages disabled), reference still S00022 for customer 'fwod36-n2 Bench Customer', and the Cancel button is gone (only "Preview" and "Set to Quotation" remain). Amounts unchanged: untaxed £1,615.00, Tax 20% £323.00, Total £1,938.00. The order is no longer active.
